# go-modern-testing-t-context

**Since:** Go 1.24

## Summary

Use t.Context() when a test function needs a context tied to the test lifetime.

## Details

t.Context returns a context tied to the test lifetime.
It removes manual background context setup when helper work should stop as the test is ending.

## Examples

### Before

```go
func TestFoo(t *testing.T) {
  ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
  defer cancel()
  result := doSomething(ctx)
}
```

### After

```go
func TestFoo(t *testing.T) {
  ctx := t.Context()
  result := doSomething(ctx)
}
```
